full_judgment: 4. It is argued before us that it will be evident from exhibits 2 and 2(f), the purchase deeds of the plaintiff-respondents, that the schedule appended therein is vague and therefore the High Court Division committed gross illegality in disturbing the finding of the appellate Court. We have considered the submission. Since it is a settled law that in case of dispute between the area and the boundary the boundary shall prevail and since there is a finding of interpolation in documents and exits 2 and 2(ka) we are not inclined to interfere with the High Court Division judgment.
